messages:
sophie: Quick preflight for onboarding halcyon-v2. Weights URI: s3://redwood-models/halcyon/v2/sha-abc123. Noticed tokenizer mapping oddity for newline — can someone confirm we won't hit split-token issues? Plan: canary in us-west1 only, pin to v2.1 for 24h, fallbacks = halcyon-v2-8bit -> halcyon-v1. Need catalog config review and a quick smoke.

devon: I pulled the weights and checksum matches the manifest. Tokenizer.json shows 'special_tokens_map' has 'newline': "\\n" -> id 50256. Our prefix caching expects id 10 in some paths. Could be an off-by-index for prefix cache eviction. @jia any past context?

jia: We saw LF vs special-token differences before. Some tokenizer versions map LF to 10, others to a high sentinel. Two options: add a compat layer in runtime or supply a catalog override. Prefer the catalog override for fast rollout. Example config snippet to add to catalog entry:

```
"token_map_overrides": {
  "newline": 10
}
```

This tells the serving runtime to treat newline as id 10 for caching/matching.

owen: Agree with doing it in catalog. Also recommend verifying `max_input_length = 4096` and running `sequence_len_stats` smoke to catch truncation edgecases. I'll run staging smoke against 5k prompts and post results here.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy halcyon-v2 -> us-west1 at 2026-03-18T15:00Z (canary=3 replicas) by @sophie

sophie: :thumbsup: Thanks. Owen — can you also confirm fallback ordering in the catalog (halcyon-v2-8bit then halcyon-v1)? And make sure `routing_policy: prefer_latency` is set for us-west canary.

owen: Catalog draft currently has fallbacks = ["halcyon-v2-8bit", "halcyon-v1"]. Routing was set to `latency_then_cost` by default; I'll change it to `prefer_latency` for the canary and push the change.

jia: FYI quant profile for halcyon-v2-8bit is running. Perf looks strong but I see some logits clipping on long contexts. Recommend adding a quality monitor on `response_length` and `perplexity_delta` so we can auto-alert on regressions.

devon: I opened a catalog PR with the token_map_overrides, fallback ordering, and routing tweak. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/catalog/pull/456 — added a smoke checklist in the description.

sophie: Nice. Add the smoke test results to the PR and mark ready-for-qa when green. We'll enable other regions after 24h stable canary.

owen: Smoke results posted: OK. latency p50=42ms p95=210ms, tokenization check on 5k prompts found 0 mismatches. Keeping us-east1 disabled for now.

jia: Adding alert rule: if tokenization_mismatch_rate > 0.5% over a 5m window, auto-roll back canary. I'll wire this into Console alerts and the rollout policy.

sophie: Perfect. Thanks all — will watch the canary. Closing thread once deploy-bot posts success.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary halcyon-v2 deployed: success. metrics: requests=3400, errors=0.4%, avg_latency=48ms. No auto-pin applied.
